sloka: ततो हलहलाशब्दो नर्मदातीर आबभौ ।अर्जुनस्यानुयातऽणां रावणस्य च मन्त्रिणाम् ।। ७.३२.३३ ॥
transliteration: tato halahalāśabdo narmadātīra ābabhau ।arjunasyānuyāta'ṇāṁ rāvaṇasya ca mantriṇām ।। 7.32.33 ॥

translations.english: Then, a great tumultuous sound arose on the bank of the Narmada, emanating from the followers of Arjuna and the ministers of Ravana.
